part.name: Lever arm with tubular socket boss
part.description: Single solid part consisting of a long rectangular prismatic arm with a rounded (cylindrical) end on one side and a short cylindrical socket/boss mounted near the opposite side of the rounded end via a smooth blended saddle. Boss includes a blind cylindrical bore.
part.symmetry_note: Approximately symmetric about the arm mid-plane (through arm thickness and centered across arm width); boss/bore appear centered laterally on the arm.

Section.name: Main arm (rectangular bar)
Section.function intent: Provide a stiff lever/handle-like member to transmit loads/moments between the rounded-end region and the boss/socket region; provide planar reference/contact surfaces.
Section.physical behavior: Primarily resists bending and torsion along its length; distributes applied loads into the boss saddle region and along the arm cross-section.
Section.geometry: Long rectangular prismatic bar with constant cross-section over most of its length; one end is terminated by a planar end face on the right, while the opposite end transitions into a rounded nose (handled in S2).
Section.location: Spans the full part length in the longitudinal direction; occupies the central band of the model; rightmost termination at x=80 per STEP bbox.

major_faces.name: Arm top major plane
major_faces.description: Large planar face of the arm (one of the two main broad faces), z=6 plane in STEP.

major_faces.name: Arm side plane (upper/positive side) main patch
major_faces.description: Long planar side face at y=23 (STEP), truncated near the boss/rounded-end transitions.

major_faces.name: Arm bottom major plane
major_faces.description: Large planar face opposite the top face, z=2 plane in STEP.

major_faces.name: Arm side plane (lower/negative side)
major_faces.description: Opposite long planar side face at y=11 (STEP).

major_faces.name: Right end face
major_faces.description: Planar end face closing the arm at the rightmost end, x=80 plane in STEP.

major_faces.name: Arm side plane (upper/positive side) small patch near rounded end
major_faces.description: Small planar side patch at y=23 near the rounded end transition (adjacent to rounded cylindrical nose surface).

Section.name: Rounded arm end (nose)
features included: Edge softening / end-profile for clearance or ergonomics
Section.function intent: Provide a rounded termination for clearance, reduced snagging, and improved stress distribution at the arm end.
Section.physical behavior: Reduces peak stresses versus a sharp corner under bending; provides a smooth contact/clearance envelope.
Section.geometry: Cylindrical surface forming the rounded end of the arm; blends into the arm’s planar faces and side faces.
Section.location: At the leftmost end of the arm (near x=-25 in STEP bbox).

major_faces.name: Rounded end cylindrical surface
major_faces.description: Cylindrical surface (radius 17.5 per STEP) forming the rounded end of the bar; cylinder axis aligned with -Z in STEP.

Section.name: Socket boss (outer tube + top ring)
features included: Interface for mating cylindrical part (outer guidance/locating reference)
Section.function intent: Provide a socket-like feature to locate and interface with a mating cylindrical component; present a robust raised boss for engagement.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a locally stiff, thick-walled region to carry bearing/contact loads from a mating component into the arm through the blend; resists ovalization under side loads.
Section.geometry: Short outer cylinder (radius 7 per STEP) with an annular planar top face (outer ring with inner hole).
Section.location: Near the arm’s left-side region (around x≈0 by STEP face centers), protruding in the +Y direction in STEP (y from ~24 to 34).

major_faces.name: Boss outer cylindrical surface
major_faces.description: Outer cylinder of the boss (radius 7 per STEP), axis along -Y in STEP.

major_faces.name: Boss top annular face (socket mouth)
major_faces.description: Planar annulus at the boss top (y=34 plane in STEP) with two boundary loops (outer rim and inner hole).

Section.name: Blind bore (inner socket cavity)
Section.function intent: Receive and locate a mating cylindrical element with a defined insertion depth (blind bore).
Section.physical behavior: Provides radial constraint to the mating part (bearing/contact on cylindrical wall) and axial stop at the bore bottom; transfers loads to the boss wall.
Section.geometry: Inner cylinder (radius 5 per STEP) with a planar circular bottom face closing the cavity; open at the top annular face of the boss.
Section.location: Coaxial with the socket boss, internal to the boss volume; extends from y=25 to y=34 in STEP (depth ~9).

major_faces.name: Bore bottom circular face
major_faces.description: Planar circular face closing the bore at y=25 in STEP (area ≈ pi*5^2).

major_faces.name: Bore inner cylindrical wall
major_faces.description: Inner cylinder (radius 5 per STEP) forming the bore wall, axis along -Y in STEP.

Section.name: Boss-to-arm blended saddle
features included: Smooth transition/blend between boss and arm
Section.function intent: Smoothly transition loads between the boss and the arm while minimizing stress concentration and providing manufacturable geometry.
Section.physical behavior: Reduces notch effects and spreads contact/bending loads from the boss into the arm over a larger area; increases local stiffness.
Section.geometry: Single BSPLINE freeform blend surface forming the saddle/fillet region under and around the boss where it meets the arm.
Section.location: At the junction of the boss and arm, centered near the boss footprint (x≈0 region), spanning around the boss base.

major_faces.name: Boss saddle blend surface
major_faces.description: BSPLINE transition surface between the boss and the arm (fillet/saddle region).
